name: Pillpod Sandmat
desc: Pillpod Sandmat (Euphorbia hirta): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Euphorbia hirta (sometimes called asthma-plant) is a pantropical weed, originating from the tropical regions of the Americas. It is a hairy herb that grows in open grasslands, roadsides and pathways.
